author: synced_reader plan, Task 6a (backup bundle versioning + timing sidecar in ZIP)
summary: Added an explicit bundle_version field to ProjectBackupBundleModel (there was no version field at all before) and taught _create_backup_archive to include the paired <wav_stem>.timing.json sidecar in the backup ZIP under the same sanitized text-derived stem the chapter WAV already uses, recording the arc path as chapter_map[chapter_id]['timing_path'] when present.

changes.change: ProjectBackupBundleModel gains bundle_version: int = 1 -- this is the top-level model serialized to bundle.json in _create_backup_archive (json.dumps(jsonable_encoder(bundle))), so it is the one contract readers (Task 6b restore) will check. ProjectExportManifestModel was left unversioned: manifest.json is a secondary/derived file, not the top-level bundle contract, so it was not touched to keep the change precise per the plan's instruction.

_create_backup_archive: after writing the chapter WAV into the ZIP, derive the sidecar path from the same resolved on-disk WAV path via .with_suffix('.timing.json') (matching chapters_assets.py's api_get_chapter_timing derivation exactly). If it exists, add it to the ZIP as chapters/{stem_name}.timing.json (the same sanitized stem the WAV uses, not the on-disk WAV's own stem) and set chapter_info['timing_path']. If absent, silently omit -- does not fail the backup.

Added test_backup_bundle_includes_bundle_version, test_backup_bundle_includes_timing_sidecar_when_present, test_backup_bundle_omits_timing_sidecar_when_absent (TDD: confirmed red against pre-change code, then green after implementation).

invariants: The ZIP arc path for both the chapter WAV and its timing sidecar must share the same sanitized stem_name (derived from the collision-disambiguated text_filename), never the on-disk WAV's own filename stem -- this is what lets a future restore (Task 6b) pair them back up unambiguously. A missing/never-generated sidecar must never fail backup creation.
note: Task 6a of design-docs/plans/active/synced_reader/. Depends on Task 4 (orchestrator) writing the sidecar and Task 5 (chapters_assets.py serving route) establishing the .with_suffix('.timing.json') derivation convention that this task mirrors -- both read-only in this task. No restore/import endpoint built here; that is Task 6b. No design-docs/specs/ file covers the backup/export bundle contract today (checked README.md router index + grepped for 'backup'/'export' -- none found), so no spec changelog row was added; flagged for whoever eventually writes one.
